premise: Hedgehog wants a hug but rolls into a prickly ball whenever someone rushes at him; Rabbit and Raccoon try a leaf-hug and a tail-hug, then wait quietly, and a nose-boop works.
inspiration: The Porcupine's Dilemma (Schopenhauer's parable), turned for four-year-olds: there is always a way to be close, and friends will invent it.
lesson: Go gently and wait, and even the prickliest friend opens up.
learning: A hedgehog rolls into a prickly ball when startled and unrolls when he feels safe.

en-US.title: Hedgehog Wants a Hug
en-US.text: Hedgehog {hedgehog:pulse} wanted a hug. He had wanted one all week. [sad] But every time somebody came close, quick, his prickles went up and — {sfx:roll} roll! — he was a ball. {hedgehog:spin} A prickly ball. Nobody can hug a prickly ball. Rabbit {rabbit:hop x2} bounced over. HUG! Roll! Ball. [surprised] Raccoon {raccoon:wobble} crept up with a big soft leaf. Leaf-hug! Roll! Ball. Rabbit tried a tail-hug. Roll! Ball. The flower {flower:wobble} sighed. [softly] Then Raccoon had an idea. Everyone sat down. Nobody moved. Nobody said HUG. They just… waited. And slowly, slowly, the ball {hedgehog:wobble 0.4} un-rolled. A nose came out. Two eyes. Hello, whispered Rabbit. Raccoon leaned in, very gently, and touched noses with Hedgehog. {sfx:boop} Boop. {hedgehog:hearts} [giggles] Hedgehog giggled. A nose hug, he said. [happily] And he was so happy that his prickles lay down flat, like grass after rain.

es-ES.title: Erizo quiere un abrazo
es-ES.text: Erizo {hedgehog:pulse} quería un abrazo. Llevaba toda la semana queriéndolo. [sad] Pero cada vez que alguien se acercaba rápido, se le erizaban las púas y — {sfx:roll} ¡ras! — ya era una bola. {hedgehog:spin} Una bola de pinchos. Nadie puede abrazar una bola de pinchos. Conejo {rabbit:hop x2} llegó botando. ¡ABRAZO! ¡Ras! Bola. [surprised] Mapache {raccoon:wobble} se acercó con una hoja blandita. ¡Abrazo de hoja! ¡Ras! Bola. Conejo probó un abrazo de cola. ¡Ras! Bola. La flor {flower:wobble} suspiró. [softly] Entonces Mapache tuvo una idea. Todos se sentaron. Nadie se movió. Nadie dijo ABRAZO. Solo… esperaron. Y despacio, despacio, la bola {hedgehog:wobble 0.4} se fue desenrollando. Salió una nariz. Dos ojos. Hola, susurró Conejo. Mapache se inclinó, despacito, y juntó su nariz con la de Erizo. {sfx:boop} Bup. {hedgehog:hearts} [giggles] Erizo se rio. Un abrazo de nariz, dijo. [happily] Y las púas se le quedaron planas, como la hierba después de la lluvia.

roll.prompt: a quick soft rustle and pop, like a small animal curling into a ball, comic and light

boop.prompt: a tiny soft boop, two noses touching, cute and short
